paragraphs.text: Kabira is a plateau formerly holding a crossroads settlement on the island of Agadeem off the coast of Ondu , on the plane of Zendikar .

The Kabira plateau formerly hosted a crossroads community of humans and other races encamped near the hedron fields. The settlement's architecture mimicked the shapes and glyphs of Agadeem's hedron fields. The Kabira Conservatory was a small academy run by the merfolk Viniva , which sponsored research of the hedrons.
During the Rise of the Eldrazi , Kabira was badly hit by Eldrazi of Ulamog 's lineage, and was left as a corrupted ruin.
The landscape later recovered, and Kabira is now home to a series of plateaus and gorges where kor come to hunt herd animals. It is unknown if the crossroads settlement was rebuilt.
